experience.title: AI Engineer Intern
experience.summary: Built a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline with LangChain, ChromaDB, and Hugging Face embeddings for semantic retrieval over real estate data, improving answer relevance and grounding responses across 500+ interactions. Designed an LLM-powered content generation pipeline that automated property descriptions, listing headlines, social media captions, and email marketing content. Implemented real-time LLM response streaming through three Flask API endpoints using Server-Sent Events (SSE) and the Groq streaming API. Orchestrated multi-step AI agent workflows in LangGraph by combining retrieval, tool calls, and task automation to deliver source-cited answers over pgvector.
